mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE falls by more than 0.2 percentage points in 3 months (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls by more than 0.5% in 1 month during a monetary tightening cycle (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand for housing, which boosts construction and related sectors, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST rises by more than 1.0% in 1 month (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is rising (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in residential mortgage credit (RSAFS) signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls by more than 0.5% in 1 month during a late-cycle expansion (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and residential mortgage credit (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand for housing and financing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST and RSAFS both rise (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
